"""Mixed-binding cycle member ``g``: import-time half plus a deferred lap.

The same module SET carries both an import-time cycle and a deferred
back-edge, and the family law is one row per set with the kind classified
exactly once — so a per-binding row would break the 1:1 between rows and
sets that the ratified key asserts.
"""

from f import f_step

G_BASE = 3


def g_step(value: int) -> int:
    return f_step(value) - 1


def g_deferred(value: int) -> int:
    from f import f_step as deferred_f

    return deferred_f(value) + 1
